name: Benchmark of Foundation Model Encoders for Histopathological Image Segmentation
description: A benchmark evaluating 15 pathology-specific foundation model encoders for histopathological image segmentation across H&E-stained histology and Annexin A5-stained immunohistochemistry modalities, focusing on representation quality disentangled from model size.
reputation: A recent pathology-focused benchmark used to compare foundation model encoders for histopathological segmentation, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Highlights that compact encoders can outperform larger models and that model size and classification accuracy are poor predictors of segmentation performance.
